reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but repeats the daily skip-versus-move policy across four consumers.

duplication.why: Daily non-working-day handling is independently implemented in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, and budget schedule calculation.

placement.why: Holiday recognition belongs appropriately in shared/schedules.ts, but schedule policy also lives in server handlers and budget calculation.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested scheduling changes, supporting configuration plumbing, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate four policy implementations with separate iteration limits, while the new handler derives its configuration type from an untyped converter despite an existing RecurConfig type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange enumerate raw occurrences and independently apply policy handled by getNextDate; schedule-template.ts disables that policy and reconstructs it locally.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily skip-versus-move decision appears as a bounded search in getNextDate, a separate iterator in getUpcomingDates, nested branches in getDatesInRange, and local predicates in schedule-template.ts.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter, getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch, and upcoming dates, range dates, and budget calculation independently implement the resulting schedule policy.
